questions.stem: 從高一就一直在整理學習歷程檔案（learning portfolio）的人，申請大學時更有優勢。
questions.answer: Those who have been organizing their learning portfolios since tenth grade have an advantage when applying to college.
accepted_answers: Students who have been working on their learning portfolios since their first year of high school have an advantage when they apply to college.
Those who have been preparing their learning portfolios since the tenth grade are at an advantage when they apply to universities.

questions.stem: 面對大學面試，這些學生和其他申請者相比，更能自信地介紹自己。
questions.answer: Faced with college interviews, these students can introduce themselves more confidently than other applicants.
accepted_answers: Facing college interviews, these students can introduce themselves with more confidence than other applicants.
Compared with other applicants, these students can introduce themselves more confidently when facing college interviews.

1.explanation_zh: 「…的人」改成 Those who …，把修飾語放到後面。「從高一就一直在整理」是從過去持續到現在的動作，用 have been organizing … since tenth grade（since 帶出起點）。主詞 Those 是複數，主要動詞用 have an advantage；「申請大學時」寫 when applying to college（apply to 某校）。
1.strategy_zh: 主詞很長時，先找出核心名詞（人），用 Those who … 把修飾語放後面，最後再接主要動詞，注意單複數一致。
hints: 切成四段：從高一就一直在整理（學習歷程檔案）／的人／申請大學時／更有優勢
標的詞彙：organize（整理，L3）、advantage（優勢，L3）、apply（申請，L2）、college（大學，L2）
句型框架：Those who + have been V-ing … since … + have an advantage + when V-ing …

2.explanation_zh: 「面對大學面試」和主要子句共用主詞 these students，可以寫成分詞構句 Faced with college interviews,（或 Facing …）。「和其他申請者相比，更能…」用比較級 more confidently than other applicants，也可以把 Compared with other applicants 放句首。「自信地」修飾動詞，用副詞 confidently。
2.strategy_zh: 兩個動作主詞相同時，可以把較次要的動作改成分詞片語放在句首；比較的對象要對等（學生和申請者比）。
hints: 切成四段：面對大學面試／這些學生／和其他申請者相比／更能自信地介紹自己
標的詞彙：face（面對，L1）、interview（面試，L1）、student（學生，L1）、introduce（介紹，L2）、confident（有自信的，L2）
句型框架：Faced with + N, S + can + VR + more + adv. + than + N（或 Compared with + N, S + V + 比較級 …）

references: Those who have been organizing their learning portfolios since tenth grade have an advantage when applying to college.
Students who have been working on their learning portfolios since their first year of high school have an advantage when they apply to college.
Those who have been preparing their learning portfolios since the tenth grade are at an advantage when they apply to universities.

patterns.label_zh: 現在完成進行式（從…起一直在…）

accepted: have been organizing their learning portfolios since tenth grade
have been working on their learning portfolios since their first year of high school
have been preparing their learning portfolios since the tenth grade
have been organizing their learning portfolios since their first year of senior high school
have been putting together their learning portfolios since tenth grade
have been working on their learning portfolios since tenth grade

common_errors.wrong: have organized their learning portfolios from tenth grade
common_errors.right: have been organizing their learning portfolios since tenth grade
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「從…起一直」用 since 搭配完成（進行）式；from 只說起點，帶不出持續到現在。

common_errors.wrong: are organizing their learning portfolios since tenth grade
common_errors.right: have been organizing their learning portfolios since tenth grade
common_errors.explanation_zh: 有 since 表示從過去持續到現在，要用現在完成進行式，不能用現在進行式。
those 是複數，who 子句的動詞用 have。
先行詞是人，關係代名詞用 who。
when 後面要接子句（when they apply）或分詞（when applying），不能直接接原形動詞。
申請進入某校是 apply to（申請某樣東西才用 apply for）。
advantage 是名詞，不能放在 be 動詞後面當形容詞；說 have an advantage 或 are at an advantage。
主詞 Those (who …) 是複數，動詞用 have。

traps.literal_error: From tenth grade always organizing learning portfolios people have more advantage when apply college.
traps.explanation_zh: 「…的人」前面的修飾語很長，英文要先寫 Those，再用 who 子句補充。

traps.literal_error: Those who have been organizing their learning portfolios are more advantage.
traps.explanation_zh: advantage 是名詞，不能當形容詞用（名詞↔形容詞的詞性誘錯）。

1.restructuring_zh: 主詞「從高一就一直在整理學習歷程檔案的人」是很長的前置修飾，英文改成 Those who have been organizing …（後位修飾），主要動詞 have 要和 Those 一致。

references: Faced with college interviews, these students can introduce themselves more confidently than other applicants.
Facing college interviews, these students can introduce themselves with more confidence than other applicants.
Compared with other applicants, these students can introduce themselves more confidently when facing college interviews.

patterns.frame: S + V + 比較級 + than + N ／ Compared with + N, S + V + 比較級 …

common_errors.explanation_zh: 句首這個部分不是祈使句，要用分詞構句 Faced with …／Facing …，主詞是後面的 these students。
face 是及物動詞，Facing 後面直接接受詞；用被動分詞時才是 Faced with。
「和…相比」用過去分詞片語 compared with／to，compare 要加 -d。
other 後面接可數名詞的複數。

accepted: can introduce themselves with more confidence
are able to introduce themselves more confidently
are more confident in introducing themselves

common_errors.explanation_zh: 修飾動詞 introduce 要用副詞 confidently（形容詞↔副詞）。
主詞是複數，反身代名詞用 themselves。

traps.literal_error: Face college interviews, these students can introduce themselves more confidently.
traps.explanation_zh: 句首用原形動詞會變成祈使句，要用分詞 Faced with／Facing。

traps.literal_error: these students can introduce themselves more confident than other applicants
traps.explanation_zh: 「自信地」修飾動詞，要用副詞 confidently，或改成 with more confidence。

1.translation: Those who have been organizing their learning portfolios since their first year of senior high school have a greater advantage when applying to universities.
1.explanation_zh: 「……的人」用 Those who；「從高一就一直在整理」用現在完成進行式 have been organizing + since；「申請大學時」用 when + V-ing 的省略子句；「更有優勢」用比較級 have a greater advantage。

2.translation: When facing college interviews, these students can introduce themselves more confidently than other applicants.
2.explanation_zh: 「面對大學面試」用 When + V-ing（也可 Faced with）；「和其他申請者相比，更能自信地」用比較級副詞 more confidently than other applicants，也可另加 Compared with other applicants 開頭，但兩者並用會重複，所以只用 than。中文「更能」也可譯 are better able to，故信心給 medium。

issues_zh: （不影響判定）三句參考譯文都寫 have an advantage／are at an advantage，沒有譯出「更」；advantage 本身含比較意味，可接受，accepted 也有 have a greater advantage。
（不影響判定）我用 When facing college interviews（連接詞＋分詞，屬 PART 代碼的 gp-conj-participle），不是句型說明寫的 Faced with／Facing 句首分詞構句；accepted 已收 when facing college interviews，程式也偵測得到。

1.translation: Students who have been organizing their learning portfolios since the first year of senior high school have a greater advantage when applying to universities.
1.explanation_zh: 「從高一就一直在整理」用 have been organizing + since，表示從過去延續到現在；「的人」改成 students who；「更有優勢」用比較級 a greater advantage。「的人」不一定限於學生，但從上下文看是學生，信心 medium。

2.translation: In university interviews, these students can introduce themselves more confidently than other applicants.
2.explanation_zh: 「面對大學面試」譯為介系詞片語 In university interviews；「更能自信地介紹自己」用副詞比較級 more confidently than；『和其他申請者相比』直接用 than 表達。

issues_zh: 「面對大學面試」我自然譯成介系詞片語 In university interviews，沒有用分詞構句（Faced with／Facing …），所以沒用到 PART 句型，標的詞彙 face 也沒用到（4/5）；中文並沒有強制引出分詞構句，「面對」也可以譯成 In／At／When facing 等。
第一部分 accepted 全是 Faced with／Facing／when facing 一類，漏了 In／At university interviews、In the face of … 等自然寫法，所以 within_accepted 判 false；建議補寫法，或在題目中加線索讓分詞構句成為唯一自然選擇。

problems: 第 2 題盲譯沒有用到標的句型 ['PART']：中文題目沒有自然引出這個句型（SPEC §5.7）
第 2 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義
